definitions.syntheticSeed: episodes inherited from the shipped warm start (models/q_table.json); generated by simulation, never observed attacker behaviour
definitions.sessionDriven: TD updates applied from scored honeypot sessions after the seed (total - syntheticSeed); 'real' in the sense of not synthetic, NOT in the sense of independent
definitions.operator: a session generated by the project's own operators (their test traffic); real but not independent
definitions.external: an independent party's session, labelled only under authorised collection; the only source that counts as independent evidence
definitions.simulated: a simulator or demo-script session that reached the learner
definitions.unknown: no valid source label (missing or not a known source); never counted as real or independent
definitions.untracked: session-driven updates learned before provenance was recorded: their source cannot be read from the table

table: operator demo table (%USERPROFILE%/.sentinelai/demo/q_table.json; read from a copy)

learning.eligibility: a scored, closed honeypot session with a session id not learned before; demo- sessions are never sent by the backend; sessions without an id are scored but never learned

updateLog.retention: last 200 updates kept (oldest dropped first); counts are kept in full

verdict: Synthetic initialisation dominates: 19 session-driven updates against 12087 synthetic seed episodes; 0 independent external sessions.
limitations: 12087 of 12106 episodes (99.84 %) are the synthetic seed.
No independent external session has been learned; no claim about real-world effectiveness can be supported.
19 session-driven updates predate provenance tracking; their source is not recorded in the table.
Servable personas without any real session: debian_11, aws_ec2, raspberry_pi.
Real sessions changed none of the 6 greedy decisions.
